details.description: ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 is OpenAI's fine-tuning offering built on the gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 snapshot from June 13, 2023, the first GPT-3.5 Turbo version OpenAI opened to custom fine-tuning (announced August 22, 2023). Rather than a chat endpoint to call directly, it is the base model developers train on their own data to produce a custom ft:-prefixed model. OpenAI's direct chat-completions access to the bare gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 snapshot was already shut down September 13, 2024, and Azure retired its equivalent gpt-35-turbo (0613) deployment on February 13, 2025. OpenAI's fine-tuning platform is now winding down for new users, and fine-tuned models built on this snapshot are scheduled to stop working October 23, 2026.
advantages: OpenAI's August 2023 launch announcement reported that early tests showed a fine-tuned GPT-3.5 Turbo could match, or even outperform, base GPT-4-level capabilities on certain narrow tasks.
OpenAI documented fine-tuning gains in steerability (e.g. reliably responding in a specified language), structured output formatting such as JSON, and matching a custom brand tone.
OpenAI reported that early fine-tuning testers reduced prompt size by up to 90% by baking repeated instructions into the model itself, speeding up each API call.
disadvantages: Direct chat-completions access to the underlying gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 snapshot was discontinued September 13, 2024, and Azure retired its equivalent deployment on February 13, 2025.
No longer offered as a base model for new fine-tuning jobs; OpenAI's current fine-tuning guide lists only the GPT-4.1 family, GPT-4o (vision) and o4-mini (reinforcement) as supported bases.
OpenAI's deprecations page schedules fine-tuned models built on this snapshot to stop working October 23, 2026, as the fine-tuning platform winds down.
4,096-token context window, well below later GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4-class fine-tuning bases.
use_cases: Fine-tuning for improved instruction-following and steerability, e.g. enforcing a specific response language
Fine-tuning for reliable structured output such as JSON, XML or YAML generation
Fine-tuning to match a custom brand tone or voice
Shortening prompts by baking repeated instructions into the fine-tuned model itself

notes: The catalog's deprecation_date (2026-10-23) matches OpenAI's deprecations page entry for the fine-tuned 'ft-gpt-3.5-turbo' snapshot group (covers both -0613 and -1106), not the earlier 2024-09-13 shutdown of direct chat-completions access to the bare 0613 snapshot; both are mentioned for clarity. openai.com blog pages return 403 to a direct fetch, so the August 2023 fine-tuning announcement was read via its Wayback Machine mirror instead.
